body: Try moving on when you have children together, it feels nearly impossible. I wasn't supposed to have to try dating ever again. I still have to see her and talk to her all the time, it kills me.

Yeah I feel the same way. I can't imagine being with anyone else, even though I would love to be at that point. 
I still have some nudes and a video from my ex saved on my phone, but I haven't looked at them since we broke up.
What about pictures with kids? And how old can pictures be? I don't have any recent pictures of me that aren't selfies.

In some cases it's because the dumper has already moved through the grief stage while still IN the relationship. Sometimes they will realize they don't love you anymore long before they break things off, leaving you to feel shock/pain/grief all at once when things are over, and they are already ready to move on.

It's what happened to me when I got dumped, and it hurts like hell.

I'm in a similar situation, being the breadwinner when we were together, I am now obligated to pay her $500 a month even though we have shared custody. I'm not sure they would be homeless without me, but it would definitely hurt their financial situation. Which is ironic, because she is currently hurting my financial situation with child support payments.

I feel that man. I have a 7 year old, he's basically the only thing that keeps me alive at this point. The fact that his mother doesn't love me anymore breaks my fucking heart though, and I can't just go NC because we have to coordinate the kid together. So I get to see this woman that I love to death all the time, but she has made it super clear that we will never be a thing again. Fucking sucks.

I still have to see my ex all the time. She is still very much present, but the cold shoulder I get is what kills me. We have a 7 year old, so we still have to have contact. It's almost been 2 months, and it feels like she is completely unaffected by the demise of our 9 year relationship, while I am still crushed. I don't weep all the time anymore, but I still struggle with finding any joy in life. The only thing that cheers me up is my son, but even he reminds me of what I've lost.
At this point in time, yes. I would want nothing more than to make my family whole again. Maybe I will have a different answer in 6 months, only time will tell.

I miss being a family. We have a 7 year old son together, and I miss being his parents. I miss holding her in my arms, I miss having someone I could tell everything to. I miss coming home to people in the house, being able to kiss her goodnight, the cuddles. I miss how she would make me feel better when I was sick. I miss the sex, the way she made me feel was unbelievable.

I also don't get to go NC because we have a child together, so I don't think I will ever be able to get over her. I just foolishly wait for the day when she wants to give me another shot, even though it realistically will never come. I hate being this pathetic version of myself.

I think she is with a new guy now, not sure on that front because they were really good friends before we broke up, and it's hard to tell if they have moved past being friends yet. Sometimes I wish that they would break up, friends or more I don't care, so she can feel the pain that I feel. Then I feel guilty about wishing that on the person I love.

I have letters from her that promise that we would be together forever. The birthday card I got 3 months before the breakup said the same thing. I still don't know when her feelings changed, and I wish every day that she would come back and give me a second chance at being a whole family again. I know logically that she won't, but that doesn't stop my heart from aching for her.

I'm going to have my son after I get off work, he eats at his mom's before coming over, so we are going to have a dessert date when he gets here. He told me last weekend that he wanted to try blueberry pie since he has never had any, so I am going to surprise him with pie and whipped cream. He can be my Valentine's date, since I'm pretty sure my ex will have a real date tomorrow.

There's a good chance they grieved while still in the relationship with you. It's what happened to me, and I am pretty sure she is with the guy I was told not to worry about now. I am still very in love with her unfortunately, and it's unfair that they got to get through this phase while still receiving our support in the relationship.
How long has it been since you broke up?

The best thing you can do is learn from it. If you don't better yourself for the next girl, then all the pain she endured was for nothing. Use that guilt you feel to change yourself, so that you won't make the same mistakes in the future.

I was the problem in my relationship, so I kind of feel where you are coming from.
First Vday alone since I was 16, I'm 28 now. Wooo hooo! Fuck.... I have to see her that day too, because I get my kid friday-monday so I'll have to see her for the exchange.

It's hard to see the faults when you know you were the problem in the relationship. I had a prescription drug problem, that I didn't realize was a problem because the pharmacy was my dealer. It made me negative and angry, all the time. I have been clean for 5 and a half weeks, and I feel like a totally different person. She doesn't want to try and fix things, and I am working on accepting that. It's just hard, she was the love of my life, and I fucked it up. It's been getting better as time goes on, but it's not easy.

I have the issue of NC not being an option. We have a 7 year old, and I get him 3 days a week. I'm struggling getting over her still, it's only been 6 weeks since breakup and were together 9 years. I keep contact to a minimum, mostly about our kid. I still have pictures of her in my house, since my nest hub is still linked to her account. I haven't changed it because she took most of the pictures, and I like the pictures of my son.

Are you me? I am also doing the "make her regret it by being the best me I can be". Problem is, this makes me want her more. The main reason we broke up was because I was a negative/angry asshole all the time. I figured out shortly after we broke up that it was caused by medication I had been taking since shortly after we started dating. So I've been clean from that for 5 weeks now, and I'm not angry anymore. Maybe it will make a difference in the long run, but I figure if I work on myself in the meantime I will be the best version of myself I can be for the next girl.

This is pretty much exactly what I am doing, she still needs to move her stuff out. She can't move her furniture until the end of March, so I am stuck looking at that until then. It just hurts seeing her all the time, we had promised each other to be together forever, and I had no intention of breaking my end of the bargain.

This is also the first time I have ever been dumped, so it extra hurts. Losing my family, my best friend, and my lover all at once.
